composition.story: Text is broken down into smaller pieces called tokens. Algorithms map these pieces to numbers before processing begins.

aha.observation: Subwords and characters handle unseen vocabulary by splitting words into known units.

states.label: Input
states.sentence: Raw text enters the tokenizer pipeline directly from the user.

states.label: Normalize
states.sentence: Text is stripped of extra whitespace and converted to lower case.

states.label: Pre-tokenize
states.sentence: Spaces and punctuation split the string into initial word chunks.

states.label: Model Split
states.sentence: BPE or WordPiece algorithms divide complex words into subwords.

states.label: Map IDs
states.sentence: Each token string is converted to a unique integer index.
states.why: Prepares numerical inputs for the neural network.
